title: Getting started
subtitle: Your first days in a new world

quests.title: Welcome
quests.subtitle: How this book works
description: This is your quest book. Each node on the page is a quest, and the lines show which quest opens which.
Click a quest to read it. When its tasks are done, come back here to claim the rewards.
Click the book under Tasks to begin.

quests.title: Timber
description: Everything starts with a tree. Gather a few logs; any kind of wood will do.

quests.title: A place to work
description: Turn a log into planks, and four planks into a crafting table. Most recipes need one.

quests.title: First pickaxe
description: Planks and sticks make a wooden pickaxe. It will not last, but it gets you to stone.

quests.title: Into the rock
description: Dig down a little and bring back some cobblestone. Stone tools are faster and sturdier than wooden ones.

quests.title: Heat
description: Eight cobblestone in a ring make a furnace. Use it to cook food and to smelt ore.

quests.title: Iron
description: Look for iron ore in caves and cliffs, then smelt it. Three ingots are enough for a pickaxe.

quests.title: A place to sleep
description: Three wool and three planks make a bed. Sleeping skips the night and sets where you come back to.

quests.title: Things in the dark
description: Monsters come out when it gets dark. Stand your ground against a few zombies.

quests.title: Leftovers
quests.subtitle: Optional
description: Zombies leave rotten flesh behind. Hand some in and get something more useful for it.
This quest takes the items: click the rotten flesh under Tasks while you carry them.

quests.title: Settled in
description: Tools, light, a bed, and you made it through the night. You are ready for what comes next.
